import sys,json,base64,hashlib,pathlib
obj=json.loads(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]).decode(''utf-8''))
report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(''materials/178-凡人只读审阅/当前产物程序核对.json'').read_text(encoding=''utf-8-sig''))[''export'']
s=obj[''text'']; sha=lambda s:hashlib.sha256(s.encode(''utf-8'')).hexdigest()
counts={''hanCharacters'':obj[''_hanCalculated''],''utf16Length'':len(s.encode(''utf-16-le''))//2,''codePoints'':len(s),''utf8Bytes'':len(s.encode(''utf-8'')),''sha256'':sha(s)}
keys=[''workId'',''workRevision'',''expectedChapters'',''savedChapters'',''allOutlineChaptersSaved'',''chapters'']
headers=[''## 第 ''+str(c[''number''])+'' 章 ''+c[''title'']+''\\n\\n'' for c in obj[''_chapters'']]
parts=[]
for i,c in enumerate(obj[''_chapters'']):
 start=s.index(headers[i])+len(headers[i]); start=s.index(''\\n\\n'',start)+2
 end=s.index(headers[i+1]) if i+1<len(headers) else len(s)
 segment=s[start:end]; body=segment[:-2] if i+1<len(headers) else segment[:-1]
 parts.append({''number'':c[''number''],''sha256'':sha(body),''matchesCurrentToolBody'':sha(body)==c[''sha256'']})
result={''counts'':counts,''reportCountsMatch'':all(counts[k]==report[k] for k in counts),''reportMetadataMatch'':all(obj[k]==report[k] for k in keys),''matchesCurrentWork'':obj[''workId'']==obj[''_currentWork''][''id''] and obj[''workRevision'']==obj[''_currentWork''][''revision''],''bodies'':parts}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
' ''"
